result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: it creates a mutual aggregate cap equal to the greater of 12 months’ fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000; retains a mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential damages; and places confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, and infringement of the other party’s IP outside the cap. It also excludes Company’s fee-payment obligations from the cap, substantively achieving the required payment-obligations treatment. The revisions are appropriately limited to the liability allocation and preserve the existing damages exclusion. Drafting is professional, with only minor issues such as the redundant phrase “total aggregate liability” and use of the 12 months preceding the event rather than preceding the claim.
